name: MinIO
summary: S3-compatible object storage server used to study object APIs, range reads, multipart transfer, and clustered storage behavior.

name: MinIO JavaScript SDK
summary: Official MinIO JavaScript client; useful for server-side S3 integration and presigned URL generation rather than as a browser runtime library.

name: aria2
summary: Mature native transfer engine used as a reference for segmented scheduling, checkpointing, retry, and integrity behavior.

name: rclone
summary: Cloud storage transfer engine with many backends; useful for studying retries, checksums, throttling, and provider abstraction.

name: Ceph
summary: Distributed storage platform providing object, block, and file interfaces; strong production reference with substantial operational complexity.

name: PostgreSQL
summary: Extensible relational database and primary reference for SQL, MVCC, WAL, indexing, and replication mechanisms.

name: CockroachDB
summary: Distributed SQL database used to study consensus-replicated ranges, MVCC transactions, rebalancing, and geo-distributed operation.

name: ClickHouse
summary: Columnar analytical database suited to studying high-throughput ingestion, vectorized queries, partitioning, and replicated analytical storage.

name: OpenSearch
summary: Distributed search and analytics engine used for full-text indexing, aggregation, log search, and cluster behavior.

name: Qdrant
summary: Vector similarity service useful for studying HNSW indexing, filtering, quantization, and operational vector-search APIs.

name: Apache Kafka
summary: Replicated event log and streaming platform used to study partitioning, consumer offsets, replay, and broker durability.

name: RabbitMQ
summary: General-purpose message broker used to compare acknowledgement, routing, redelivery, queue, and clustering semantics.

name: NATS Server
summary: Lightweight messaging server with request/reply and durable stream capabilities; useful for low-latency service messaging comparisons.

name: Temporal
summary: Durable execution platform used to study event history, deterministic replay, activity retries, and long-running workflow recovery.

name: Argo Workflows
summary: Kubernetes-native DAG workflow controller used for containerized job orchestration, retries, artifacts, and workflow state.

name: Kubernetes
summary: Canonical container orchestration implementation and primary reference for declarative APIs, controllers, scheduling, and cluster operations.

name: K3s
summary: Compact Kubernetes distribution useful for edge and constrained deployments while retaining the Kubernetes control-loop model.

name: Argo CD
summary: Kubernetes GitOps controller used to study desired-state synchronization, health assessment, drift detection, and rollback workflows.

name: Flux
summary: Composable GitOps toolkit used to compare source reconciliation, dependency handling, and in-cluster desired-state controllers.

name: Crossplane
summary: Kubernetes control-plane framework for cloud resources and platform APIs; useful for composition and provider reconciliation patterns.

name: Envoy
summary: Programmable proxy and common data plane for gateways and service meshes; strong reference for filters, xDS, routing, and telemetry.

name: Kong Gateway
summary: Plugin-oriented API gateway used to compare routing, authentication, rate limiting, and operational API-management patterns.

name: Apache APISIX
summary: Dynamic API gateway used to study route updates, plugins, upstream management, and cloud-native traffic policy.

name: Istio
summary: Feature-rich service-mesh control plane used to study identity, mTLS, traffic policy, and Envoy-based data-plane management.

name: Cilium
summary: eBPF-based Kubernetes networking and security implementation used for kernel data-plane, policy, and flow-observability analysis.

name: Prometheus
summary: Pull-based metrics monitoring system and primary reference for scraping, label queries, local time series, and alert evaluation.

name: Grafana
summary: Observability visualization and alerting platform used to compare data-source integration, dashboards, and operational user experience.

name: OpenTelemetry Collector
summary: Vendor-neutral telemetry pipeline reference for receivers, processors, exporters, batching, and agent-versus-gateway deployment.

name: Jaeger
summary: Distributed tracing backend used to study collection, sampling, storage integration, and trace query workflows.

name: Fluent Bit
summary: Resource-conscious log and telemetry agent used to study parsing, buffering, backpressure, and multi-backend delivery.

name: Keycloak
summary: Identity and access management server used to evaluate OIDC, OAuth, SAML federation, realms, and operational identity concerns.

name: Open Policy Agent
summary: General policy engine and Rego reference used for authorization, admission control, and policy-as-code design.

name: Kyverno
summary: Kubernetes-native policy engine used to compare validation, mutation, generation, audit, and admission-controller operations.

name: Trivy
summary: Artifact and configuration scanner used to evaluate vulnerability databases, SBOM generation, secret detection, and CI integration.

name: OpenBao
summary: Open secrets-management server used to study dynamic credentials, leases, revocation, audit, and high-availability design.

name: OpenTofu
summary: Declarative infrastructure-as-code engine used to study plans, state, provider protocols, locking, and reproducible provisioning.

name: Terraform
summary: Widely adopted infrastructure-as-code engine and ecosystem reference; current licensing must be verified for the intended use.

name: Pulumi
summary: Programmable infrastructure-as-code engine used to compare general-purpose language models, previews, state, and provider ecosystems.

name: Tekton Pipelines
summary: Kubernetes-native pipeline controller used to study task graphs, isolated runs, workspaces, and CI control loops.

name: Backstage
summary: Developer portal framework used to evaluate software catalogs, plugins, scaffolding, and internal platform product design.

name: Knative Serving
summary: Kubernetes serverless serving layer used to study revisions, routing, request concurrency, autoscaling, and scale-to-zero behavior.

name: OpenFaaS
summary: Function platform used to compare function packaging, gateway invocation, autoscaling, and Kubernetes-oriented operations.

name: KEDA
summary: Event-driven Kubernetes autoscaler used to study scaler adapters, external metrics, activation thresholds, and scale-to-zero.

name: Dapr
summary: Distributed application runtime used to compare sidecar building blocks for service invocation, pub/sub, state, and bindings.

name: workerd
summary: Edge JavaScript runtime used as a contrasting reference for isolate-based execution and capability-oriented APIs outside Kubernetes.

name: Apache Spark
summary: General distributed data engine used to study DAG execution, shuffle, SQL, batch, and micro-batch streaming trade-offs.

name: Apache Flink
summary: Stateful stream-processing engine used to study event time, checkpoints, state backends, recovery, and exactly-once state semantics.

name: Apache Iceberg
summary: Transactional table format used to study snapshots, manifests, schema and partition evolution, and engine interoperability on object storage.

name: Trino
summary: Distributed SQL query engine used to evaluate connector-based federation, lakehouse access, scheduling, and interactive analytics.

name: Debezium
summary: Log-based CDC platform used to study offsets, schema history, source connectors, outbox integration, and change-event delivery.

name: Kubeflow
summary: Kubernetes ML platform ecosystem used to evaluate notebooks, pipelines, training, serving integrations, and multi-user operations.

name: MLflow
summary: ML lifecycle platform used to compare experiment tracking, artifacts, model packaging, registries, and deployment handoff.

name: Ray
summary: Distributed Python compute framework used to study task and actor scheduling, training, serving, and autoscaling for AI workloads.

name: KServe
summary: Kubernetes model-serving control plane used to evaluate inference services, autoscaling, rollout, storage initialization, and serving runtimes.

name: vLLM
summary: LLM inference engine used to study continuous batching, memory management, serving APIs, and GPU throughput trade-offs.

name: SeaweedFS
summary: Distributed file and object store used to compare volume placement, metadata services, S3 compatibility, and small-file handling.

name: JuiceFS
summary: Object-backed distributed filesystem used to study metadata separation, client caching, POSIX access, and Kubernetes storage integration.

name: restic
summary: Content-addressed backup tool used to study chunking, encryption, snapshots, integrity verification, and repository maintenance.

name: Kopia
summary: Snapshot-oriented backup system used to compare content-defined chunking, encryption, repository formats, policies, and server mode.

name: Syncthing
summary: Continuous peer file-synchronization system used as a contrasting reference for block hashes, discovery, conflict handling, and replication.
